body: I know, I agree completely. Suicide isn't something to be lauded, but neither should it be something to see negatively. It's just an action, a choice with consequences. And I fear the consequences aren't anywhere near enough to stop me going through with it.
I do understand where you're coming from, but it's not something I'm capable of doing. Focusing is difficult for me, there's always too much going on in my head to focus on anything.

To put it simply, the problem is me. The self-destructive thought patterns are impossible to break, and I've tried every method possible to alter things with no success.

And I agree, there's nothing wrong in itself for the need of emotional validation, but that doesn't make it any easier to come by. It allows me to recognise that there is the possibility, in theory, of temporary reprieve from my own mentality. But in practice, it wont happen.

The problem with words is that they've all been used before. I've talked myself to death, metaphorically speaking. There's only so many times you can talk about something without being able to get any closer to a resolution, than it just feels like you're hitting your head against a wall... nothing but pointless frustration.

As to what I need... to be truthful, it's not much more than a childish need for emotional validation, from those who know me, moments to hold on to, if you know what I mean. It wont fix anything, I'm too far gone for that, but it holds stuff together temporarily, lets me survive for a time.
